title: GNSS
hintDrawerPanel:
Where the tracking panel is shown: on the left side of the map, on the right side, or not at all.

When hidden, you can still access the location settings from the Settings screen.
hintCenterMode: Keep the map centered on your GNSS position. You can pan away freely — after the configured delay the map flies back.
hintRecenterDelay: Seconds of stillness after panning away before the map returns to your GNSS position.
confirmDeactivateRecording: Track recording is active. Stop GNSS tracking?
permissionDenied: Location permission is required to use GNSS. Please enable it in the system settings.
hintMarkerDirection: Whether the marker points in your moving direction or turns with your device compass.
hintAccuracyCircle: The circle is drawn with the radius of the current GNSS accuracy whenever the accuracy is worse than this threshold (in your distance unit). 0 disables the circle.
hintShowMeasurementLabel: Show the distance/bearing measurement label while the map is panned away from your GNSS position.
hintMarkerFile: The marker icon: the built-in triangle, or a custom SVG/PNG file from the marker directory.
hintMarkerColor: Marker fill color (applies to the built-in triangle and the accuracy circle).
hintMarkerPreview: Live preview of the configured marker.
